current_phase.label: Public /chat route verified and product acceptance closeout

current_milestone.label: Unified-account entry, onboarding, homepage, and one real DeepSeek round-trip are live

progress_summary: This repo remains the deployment wrapper for the official LobeHub image on the local Mac. The public `/chat` route uses root-domain OIDC, LobeHub email/password login stays disabled, mounted-path custom image patches remain required, and DeepSeek remains the only provider that has been live-validated end to end. On 2026-05-26, Docker Desktop resource allocation was raised from the previously tight 4 GiB / 2 CPU baseline to an 8 GiB / 4 CPU / 2 GiB swap baseline for the full local stack, and the health probe was adjusted so volatile Chinese finance SearXNG misses warn by default instead of triggering watcher container recreation. Default release health still verifies local LobeHub reachability, root-domain OIDC bootstrap, SearXNG JSON with a stable English result path, and Browserless crawl; strict Chinese finance search remains available with `LOBE_STRICT_SEARCH_HEALTH=1` for manual acceptance.
blockers: Non-DeepSeek provider keys in `deploy/.env` remain placeholders, so Anthropic/OpenAI/Google model validation is still intentionally out of scope for this round.

The live app still emits low-priority asset noise such as missing `favicon-progress.ico` variants, but this does not block auth, onboarding, homepage delivery, search, crawl, or the validated DeepSeek chat path.

Official LobeHub Market cloud-skill authorization is still intentionally not part of the baseline until this domain has valid `MARKET_TRUSTED_CLIENT_ID` and `MARKET_TRUSTED_CLIENT_SECRET` credentials registered with redirect `https://hernando-zhao.cn/market-auth-callback`; local Office/file/skill workflows must not depend on that path.
next_step: Keep `/chat` acceptance tied to real browser runs and log scans. Use default `health-search` for watcher self-healing and `LOBE_STRICT_SEARCH_HEALTH=1 scripts/lobehubctl.sh health-search` when manually validating strict Chinese finance search quality.
